title: On the number of vertices of projective polytopes
abstract: Let $X$ be a configuration of $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^d$.   What is the maximum number of vertices that $conv(T(X))$ can have among all the possible permissible projective transformations $T$?   In this paper, we investigate this and connected questions. After presenting several upper bounds, we study a closely related problem (via Gale transforms) concerning the number of minimal Radon partitions of a set of points. We then present some bounds for this number that enable us to partially answer a question due to Pach and Szegedy. We also discuss another related problem concerning the size of topes in arrangements of hyperplanes.
relevance_reason: Tope의 크기(size of topes in arrangements of hyperplanes)와 Gale transform을 통한 점 배치 문제를 다루며, McMullen 문제의 핵심 구조인 oriented matroid의 tope graph와 부분적으로 연결된다.
summary: 이 논문은 $\mathbb{R}^d$의 $n$점 집합 $X$에 대해 허용 가능한 사영변환 $T$ 중 $\text{conv}(T(X))$의 꼭짓점 수를 최대화하는 문제를 연구한다. Gale 변환을 통해 이를 점 집합의 최소 Radon 분할(minimal Radon partitions)의 수 문제와 연결하고, 관련 상한들을 제시하여 Pach와 Szegedy의 질문에 부분적으로 답한다. 또한 초평면 배열(arrangements of hyperplanes)에서 tope의 크기에 관한 관련 문제도 논의한다.
technique: Gale 변환(Gale transform)을 이용하여 사영 볼록 껍질의 꼭짓점 수 문제를 최소 Radon 분할의 수 문제로 변환하고 상한 도출.
connections: 추측: tope의 크기 분석이 oriented matroid의 tope graph 구조와 연결될 수 있으며, 이는 McMullen 문제의 acyclic reorientation 관점과 간접적으로 관련될 수 있다.

title: Projective Equivalences of k-neighbourly Polytopes
abstract: We prove the following theorem, which is related to McMullen's problem on projective transformations of polytopes; let $2\leq k\leq \lfloor{\frac{d}{2}}\rfloor$ and $ν{(d, k)}$ be the largest number such that any set of $ν{(d,k)}$ points lying in general position in $\mathbb{R}^d$ can be mapped by a permissible projective transformation onto the vertices of a k-neighborly polytope, then $d + \left\lceil{\frac{d}{k}}\right\rceil +1 \leq ν{(d, k)} < 2d-k +1$.
comment: Submitted to Contributions to Discrete Mathematics
relevance_reason: 이 논문은 McMullen's problem(일반 위치 점들을 사영 변환으로 k-neighborly polytope의 꼭짓점으로 보낼 수 있는 최대 점 개수 ν(d,k) 결정)을 직접 다루며, Larman conjecture와 밀접히 연관된 경계 $d + \lceil d/k \rceil + 1 \leq \nu(d,k) < 2d-k+1$을 증명한다.
summary: 이 논문은 $\mathbb{R}^d$의 일반 위치 점 집합을 허용 가능한 사영 변환(permissible projective transformation)으로 $k$-neighborly polytope의 꼭짓점 집합으로 매핑할 수 있는 최대 점 개수 $\nu(d,k)$에 관한 McMullen 문제를 연구한다. 주요 결과로 $2 \leq k \leq \lfloor d/2 \rfloor$ 범위에서 $d + \lceil d/k \rceil + 1 \leq \nu(d,k) < 2d - k + 1$임을 증명한다. 특히 $k=1$일 때의 알려진 결과를 일반화하여 $k$-neighborly polytope로의 사영 동치성에 대한 경계를 제시한다.
technique: 허용 가능한 사영 변환의 성질 분석과 조합론적 논증을 통해 $\nu(d,k)$의 하한과 상한을 각각 구성적·배제적 방법으로 확립.
connections: Larman conjecture $f(5)=11$과 직접 연결: $d=5, k=2$이면 $\nu(5,2)$의 하한이 $5 + \lceil 5/2 \rceil + 1 = 9$, 상한이 $2\cdot5-2+1=9$로 일치하여 $\nu(5,2)=9$가 되는지 확인 필요(초록만으로는 불확실); McMullen 문제의 $d=5$ 경우에 대한 경계를 직접 제공한다.

title: On $k$-neighborly reorientations of oriented matroids
abstract: We study the existence and the number of $k$-neighborly reorientations of an oriented matroid. This leads to $k$-variants of McMullen's problem and Roudneff's conjecture, the case $k=1$ being the original statements on complete cells in arrangements. Adding to results of Larman and García-Colín, we provide new bounds on the $k$-McMullen's problem and prove the conjecture for several ranks and $k$ by computer. Further, we show that $k$-Roudneff's conjecture for fixed rank and $k$ reduces to a finite case analyse. As a consequence we prove the conjecture for odd rank $r$ and $k=\frac{r-1}{2}$ as well as for rank $6$ and $k=2$ with the aid of the computer.
relevance_reason: 본 논문은 McMullen's problem의 $k$-변형과 Roudneff's conjecture를 oriented matroid의 $k$-neighborly reorientation 존재성·개수 문제로 일반화하여 직접 연구한다.
summary: 저자들은 oriented matroid의 $k$-neighborly reorientation의 존재 및 개수를 연구하며, 이를 통해 McMullen's problem과 Roudneff's conjecture의 $k$-변형($k=1$이 원래 배열에서의 완전 셀 문제)을 도입한다. Larman과 García-Colín의 결과에 더해 $k$-McMullen's problem에 대한 새로운 경계를 제시하고, 컴퓨터 계산으로 여러 rank와 $k$에서 conjecture를 검증한다. 특히 홀수 rank $r$과 $k=\frac{r-1}{2}$의 경우 및 rank 6, $k=2$의 경우에 $k$-Roudneff's conjecture를 증명한다.
technique: 유한 경우 분석으로의 환원(finite case reduction)과 컴퓨터 보조 증명을 핵심 기법으로 사용한다.
connections: McMullen's problem(f(5)=11 관련 Larman conjecture)과 직접 연결되며, oriented matroid의 reorientation 이론 및 배열에서의 완전 셀(complete cell) 계수 문제와 긴밀히 연관된다.

title: On sets projectively equivalent to the vertices of a convex polytope
abstract: We determine the largest number nu(d) such that any nu(d) points in general position in R^d can be mapped by a permissible projective transformation onto the vertices of a convex polytope. We prove the lower bound nu(d) >= 2d+1 using Gale transforms and Radon partitions, establishing Larman's conjecture that nu(d) = 2d+1. The reformulation via totally cyclic oriented matroids and acyclic reorientations is central to the proof.
relevance_reason: 이 논문은 Larman의 추측 $\nu(d) = 2d+1$을 직접 증명하며, acyclic reorientation과 totally cyclic oriented matroid를 핵심 도구로 사용하여 McMullen 문제와 직결된다.
summary:
이 논문은 $\mathbb{R}^d$에서 일반 위치(general position)에 있는 점들을 허용 가능한 사영 변환(permissible projective transformation)으로 볼록 다면체의 꼭짓점에 대응시킬 수 있는 최대 점의 수 $
u(d)$를 결정한다. Gale 변환과 Radon 분할을 이용하여 $
u(d) \geq 2d+1$의 하한을 증명하고, Larman의 추측 $
u(d) = 2d+1$을 확립한다. 증명의 핵심은 totally cyclic oriented matroid와 acyclic reorientation을 통한 재정식화이다.
technique: Gale 변환(Gale transform)과 Radon 분할(Radon partition)을 이용한 하한 증명, 및 totally cyclic oriented matroid의 acyclic reorientation으로의 재정식화.
connections: McMullen 문제($d=5$의 경우 $f(5)=11$)는 $\nu(d)=2d+1$과 직접 연관되며, 본 논문의 oriented matroid 및 acyclic reorientation 프레임워크는 McMullen 문제 해결에 핵심적인 도구를 제공한다.

title: Roudneff's Conjecture for Lawrence Oriented Matroids
abstract: We prove Roudneff's conjecture for Lawrence oriented matroids: every arrangement of n pseudohyperplanes in projective space P^{d-1} has a cell meeting all n pseudohyperplanes, provided n >= 2d. This is closely related to McMullen's problem on convex position of point configurations and the study of acyclic reorientations. The result gives new bounds on f(d).
relevance_reason: Lawrence oriented matroid의 Roudneff 추측 증명이 McMullen의 문제(convex position), acyclic reorientation, 그리고 f(d)의 새로운 경계와 직접적으로 연결된다고 명시되어 있다.
summary: 이 논문은 Lawrence oriented matroid에 대한 Roudneff 추측을 증명한다: $n \geq 2d$이면 사영 공간 $P^{d-1}$의 $n$개의 pseudo-hyperplane 배열에는 모든 $n$개의 pseudo-hyperplane과 만나는 cell이 존재한다. 이 결과는 McMullen의 볼록 위치 점 배치 문제 및 acyclic reorientation 연구와 밀접하게 관련되어 있으며, $f(d)$에 대한 새로운 경계를 제공한다.
technique: 초록만으로는 구체적 기법 불확실; Lawrence oriented matroid의 구조적 성질을 활용한 것으로 서술됨.
connections: 초록에서 McMullen's problem on convex position, acyclic reorientation, 그리고 $f(d)$의 새 경계를 직접 언급하며, Larman 추측 $f(5)=11$과의 관련성은 추측: $f(d)$ 경계 개선을 통해 $d=5$ 경우에도 영향을 줄 가능성이 있다.

title: Matching fields and lattice points of simplices
abstract: We show that the Chow covectors of a linkage matching field define a bijection between certain degree vectors and lattice points, and we demonstrate how one can recover the linkage matching field from this bijection. This resolves two open questions from Sturmfels and Zelevinsky (1993) on linkage matching fields. For this, we give an explicit construction that associates a bipartite incidence graph of an ordered partition of a common set to each lattice point in a dilated simplex. Given a triangulation of a product of two simplices encoded by a set of spanning trees on a bipartite node set, we similarly prove that the bijection from left to right degree vectors of the trees is enough to recover the triangulation. As additional results, we show a cryptomorphic description of linkage matching fields and characterise the flip graph of a linkage matching field in terms of its prodsimplicial flag complex. Finally, we relate our findings to transversal matroids through the tropical Stiefel map.
comment: 38 pages, 22 figures. Final published version, Advances in Mathematics, Volume 370 (2020)
relevance_reason: 논문은 linkage matching field의 두 미해결 문제(Sturmfels–Zelevinsky 1993)를 해결하며, Chow covector, 삼각분할(triangulation of product of simplices), tropical Stiefel map을 통해 matching field 이론의 핵심 구조를 직접 다룬다.
summary: 이 논문은 linkage matching field의 Chow covector가 특정 degree vector와 격자점(lattice point) 사이의 전단사 함수를 정의함을 보이고, 이 전단사 함수로부터 matching field를 복원할 수 있음을 증명하여 Sturmfels–Zelevinsky(1993)의 두 미해결 문제를 해결한다. 또한 두 simplex의 곱의 삼각분할을 이분 노드 집합 위의 spanning tree로 인코딩할 때, left/right degree vector 간의 전단사 함수만으로 삼각분할 전체를 복원할 수 있음을 보인다. 추가로 linkage matching field의 cryptomorphic 서술, flip graph와 prodsimplicial flag complex의 관계, tropical Stiefel map을 통한 transversal matroid와의 연결을 제시한다.
technique: dilated simplex의 각 격자점에 공통 집합의 순서 분할(ordered partition)의 이분 incidence graph를 명시적으로 대응시키는 구성을 핵심 도구로 사용한다.
connections: tropical geometry 및 triangulation of product of simplices와 직접 연결되며, tropical Stiefel map을 통해 transversal matroid와도 관련된다; 추측: Lawrence oriented matroid의 실현가능성(realizability) 문제와도 연관될 수 있음.

title: Toric degenerations of Grassmannians from matching fields
abstract: We study the algebraic combinatorics of monomial degenerations of Plücker forms which is governed by matching fields in the sense of Sturmfels and Zelevinsky. We provide a necessary condition for a matching field to yield a Khovanskii basis of the Plücker algebra for $3$-planes in $n$-space. When the ideal associated to the matching field is quadratically generated this condition is both necessary and sufficient. Finally, we describe a family of matching fields, called $2$-block diagonal, whose ideals are quadratically generated. These matching fields produce a new family of toric degenerations of $\Gr(3, n)$.
relevance_reason: matching field의 조합론적 성질과 toric degeneration(다면체 구조)을 직접 연구하며, Sturmfels–Zelevinsky의 matching field 개념을 Plücker 대수의 Khovanskii basis 조건으로 확장한다.
summary: 이 논문은 Plücker 형식의 단항식 degeneration을 지배하는 matching field의 대수적 조합론을 연구한다. $\mathrm{Gr}(3,n)$에 대해 matching field가 Plücker 대수의 Khovanskii basis를 생성하기 위한 필요조건을 제시하며, 관련 아이디얼이 이차생성(quadratically generated)일 때는 필요충분조건이 됨을 보인다. 나아가 '2-block diagonal' matching field 족을 정의하고, 이들이 $\mathrm{Gr}(3,n)$의 새로운 toric degeneration 족을 생성함을 보인다.
technique: Plücker 대수의 Khovanskii basis 이론과 matching field 아이디얼의 이차생성 조건을 결합하여 toric degeneration을 구성한다.
connections: matching field는 polyhedral matching field 및 tropical Grassmannian의 삼각분할(triangulation)과 밀접히 연결되며, 본 논문의 toric degeneration 구성은 regular triangulation 실현가능성 문제와 연관될 수 있다.

title: Matching Fields in Macaulay2
abstract: This article introduces the package MatchingFields for Macaulay2 and highlights some open problems. A matching field is a combinatorial object whose data encodes a candidate toric degeneration of a Grassmannian or partial flag variety of type A. Each coherent matching field is associated to a certain maximal cone of the respective tropical variety. The MatchingFields package provides methods to construct matching fields along with their rings, ideals, polyhedra and matroids. The package also supplies methods to test whether a matching field is coherent, linkage and gives rise to a toric degeneration.
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, code maintained on github, see https://github.com/ollieclarke8787/matching_fields
relevance_reason: Matching field의 조합론적 구조, coherent matching field와 열대기하학(tropical variety)의 최대 cone, toric degeneration 판정 등을 다루며, polyhedral matching fields 및 regular triangulation과 직접 관련된 계산 패키지를 소개한다.
summary: 이 논문은 Macaulay2용 패키지 MatchingFields를 소개하며, matching field의 ring, ideal, polyhedra, matroid를 구성하는 메서드를 제공한다. Coherent matching field는 Grassmannian 또는 부분 flag variety의 toric degeneration 후보를 인코딩하는 조합론적 객체로, 각각의 열대 다양체(tropical variety)의 최대 cone에 대응된다. 패키지는 matching field의 coherence, linkage, toric degeneration 여부를 판정하는 메서드도 포함하며, 몇 가지 미해결 문제를 제시한다.
technique: Macaulay2 소프트웨어를 통해 matching field에 연관된 대수적·조합론적·다면체적 구조(ring, ideal, polyhedra, matroid)를 계산적으로 구성하고 검증하는 방법론.
connections: Coherent matching field가 열대 Grassmannian의 최대 cone에 대응된다는 점은 polyhedral matching fields 및 regular triangulation과 직접 연결되며, realizability 및 chirotope 문제와도 관련될 가능성이 있다.

title: A problem of McMullen on the projective equivalences of polytopes
abstract: We give a version for oriented matroids of the McMullen problem: determine the largest number f(d) such that f(d) points in general position in d-dimensional real space may be mapped by a permissible projective transformation onto the vertices of a convex polytope. We prove that for every orientation of the uniform matroid on 2r-1 elements of rank r with r at least 3, there is an acyclic reorientation such that all points are extreme points. This recovers the Larman lower bound f(d) is at least 2d+1 via oriented matroids and chirotopes.
relevance_reason: 이 논문은 McMullen's problem의 oriented matroid 버전을 직접 다루며, Larman의 하한 $f(d) \geq 2d+1$을 oriented matroid와 chirotope를 통해 재증명한다.
summary: 이 논문은 McMullen 문제—$d$차원 실공간에서 general position에 있는 $f(d)$개의 점을 사영 변환으로 볼록 다면체의 꼭짓점으로 보낼 수 있는 최대 수 결정—를 oriented matroid의 언어로 정식화한다. rank $r$($r \geq 3$)의 $2r-1$개 원소를 갖는 uniform matroid의 임의의 orientation에 대해 모든 점이 extreme point가 되는 acyclic reorientation이 존재함을 증명한다. 이를 통해 Larman의 하한 $f(d) \geq 2d+1$을 oriented matroid 및 chirotope를 이용해 복원한다.
technique: Uniform matroid의 임의 orientation에 대해 acyclic reorientation을 구성하는 oriented matroid 이론 및 chirotope를 핵심 도구로 사용한다.
connections: Larman conjecture $f(5)=11$의 하한 $f(d) \geq 2d+1$ 부분을 oriented matroid 관점에서 재증명하며, Lawrence oriented matroid 및 acyclic reorientation 개념과 직접 연결된다.

title: Lawrence oriented matroids and a problem of McMullen on projective equivalences of polytopes
abstract: We consider the McMullen problem: determine the largest integer f(d) such that any set of f(d) points in general position in affine d-dimensional space can be mapped by a projective transformation onto the vertices of a convex polytope. Using Lawrence oriented matroids, we prove a new upper bound showing that f(d) is strictly less than 2d plus the ceiling of (d+1)/2, improving the previous bound of (d+1)(d+2)/2. The technique analyzes acyclic reorientations of Lawrence oriented matroids and tope structure.
relevance_reason: McMullen 문제의 f(d) 상한을 Lawrence oriented matroid와 acyclic reorientation·tope 구조를 이용해 직접 개선하는 논문으로, 연구 문제의 핵심 요소 전체를 다룬다.
summary: 이 논문은 아핀 $d$차원 공간에서 일반 위치의 점 집합을 사영 변환으로 볼록 다면체의 꼭짓점으로 보낼 수 있는 최대 크기 $f(d)$를 결정하는 McMullen 문제를 다룬다. Lawrence oriented matroid를 활용하여 $f(d) < 2d + \lceil(d+1)/2\rceil$라는 새로운 상한을 증명하였으며, 이는 기존 상한 $(d+1)(d+2)/2$를 개선한다. 핵심 기법은 Lawrence oriented matroid의 acyclic reorientation과 tope 구조 분석이다.
technique: Lawrence oriented matroid의 acyclic reorientation 및 tope 구조를 분석하여 $f(d)$의 새로운 상한을 도출.
connections: Larman conjecture $f(5)=11$에 대해, 새 상한 $f(5) < 2\cdot5+\lceil6/2\rceil=13$이 이전 상한 $\frac{6\cdot7}{2}=21$보다 강하나 $f(5)=11$ 확인에는 추가 분석이 필요함; tope graph 및 signed permutation과의 연관은 초록에 직접 언급되지 않아 추측: tope graph 구조가 general/convex position 판별에 활용되었을 가능성이 있음.

title: A Combinatorial Characterization of Sol 3-Manifolds
abstract: We show that there is a universal compact branched 3-manifold $W$ such that a closed 3-manifold $M$ immerses into $W$ if and only if $M$ admits a Sol structure. Equivalently, a closed 3-manifold is Sol if and only if it has a certain type of triangulation. The construction of $W$ is based on a regular language that characterizes Sol manifolds.
relevance_reason: 이 논문은 Sol 3-다양체의 조합론적 특성화에 관한 것으로, McMullen 문제(볼록 위치 점 배치, oriented matroid 등)와 직접적 관련이 없다.
summary: 이 논문은 닫힌 3-다양체 $M$이 Sol 구조를 가질 필요충분조건이 보편적 컴팩트 분기 3-다양체 $W$에 몰입(immerse)되는 것임을 보인다. 동치적으로, 닫힌 3-다양체가 Sol인 것은 특정 유형의 삼각분할을 가지는 것과 동치이다. $W$의 구성은 Sol 다양체를 특성화하는 정규 언어(regular language)에 기반한다.
technique: Sol 다양체를 특성화하는 정규 언어를 이용하여 보편적 컴팩트 분기 3-다양체를 구성하는 기법.

title: Homotopy Coherent Nielsen Realization Problem for Dehn Twists on K3-Type 4-Manifolds
abstract: We study the homotopy coherent version of the Nielsen realization problem for smooth $4$-manifolds. Given a finite subgroup $G\subset π_0(\mathrm{Diff}(M))$, this problem asks whether there is a map $H\colon BG \to B\mathrm{Diff}(M)$ such that the induced map on fundamental groups coincides with the inclusion of $G$. Using family Seiberg-Witten theory, we prove that for $K3$-type $4$-manifolds, the Dehn twists along $(-2)$-spheres are not homotopy coherently Nielsen realizable. In particular, this gives an alternative proof of the failure of the classical Nielsen realization problem in this setting.
relevance_reason: 이 논문은 4-다양체(K3형)의 Dehn twist에 대한 Nielsen 실현 문제를 다루며, McMullen 문제나 oriented matroid, 볼록 위치 점 배치와 전혀 무관하다.
summary: 이 논문은 매끄러운 4-다양체에 대한 호모토피 일관(homotopy coherent) Nielsen 실현 문제를 연구한다. Family Seiberg-Witten 이론을 사용하여, K3형 4-다양체에서 $(-2)$-구면을 따른 Dehn twist들이 호모토피 일관 방식으로 Nielsen 실현 불가능함을 증명한다. 이는 고전적인 Nielsen 실현 문제의 실패에 대한 대안적 증명도 제공한다.
technique: Family Seiberg-Witten 이론을 활용하여 $BG 	o B\mathrm{Diff}(M)$의 존재성을 반박한다.

title: Odd cycles in symmetric Cayley graphs on prime cyclic groups
abstract: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $S\subseteq \Z_p$ be symmetric with $0\notin S$. Let $\Cay(\Z_p,S)$ be the undirected Cayley graph on $\Z_p$ in which $x$ and $y$ are adjacent if and only if $x-y\in S$. For $1\le \ell\le (p-1)/2$, define \[ \ex_{\Cay}(C_{2\ell+1},\Z_p)=\max\{|S|: S=-S,\ 0\notin S,\ \Cay(\Z_p,S)\text{ contains no }C_{2\ell+1}\}. \] Confirming a conjecture of Cashman and Kelley, we prove that if $p=2\ell+1$, then $\ex_{\Cay}(C_{2\ell+1},\Z_p)=0$, while if $p>2\ell+1$, then \[ \ex_{\Cay}(C_{2\ell+1},\Z_p)=2\floor{\frac{p+2\ell+1}{2(2\ell+1)}}. \] The proof combines a sharp additive zero-sum odd-girth argument with weak odd pancyclicity to transfer the result from odd-girth exclusion to fixed odd-cycle exclusion. We also give a canonical extremal family, an exact extremality criterion in terms of odd zero-sum avoidance, and an example showing that extremizers need not be dilates of the canonical construction.
relevance_reason: 대칭 Cayley 그래프의 홀수 사이클 제외 문제로, McMullen's problem(볼록 위치의 점 배치와 oriented matroid)과는 직접적 관련이 없음.
summary: 본 논문은 소수 $p$에 대해 $\mathbb{Z}_p$ 위의 대칭 Cayley 그래프에서 홀수 사이클 $C_{2\ell+1}$을 포함하지 않는 최대 대칭 생성원소 집합의 크기를 결정한다. Cashman-Kelley 추측을 확인하여 $p=2\ell+1$일 때는 0, $p>2\ell+1$일 때는 $2\lfloor\frac{p+2\ell+1}{2(2\ell+1)}\rfloor$임을 증명한다.
technique: 덧셈적 영영합(additive zero-sum) 홀수-girth 논증과 약한 홀수 pancyclicity를 결합하여 홀수-girth 제외 결과를 고정 홀수-사이클 제외로 전이.

title: Improved asymptotic upper bound on the $n$-queens completion threshold
abstract: The $n$-queens completion threshold $qc(n)$ is the largest integer $k < n$ such that any placement of $k$ mutually non-attacking queens on an $n \times n$ chessboard can be completed to an $n$-queens configuration by adding $n - k$ queens. For all sufficiently large $n$, we improve the previously best-known upper bound on $qc(n)$ from $qc(n) \leq 0.241n$ to $qc(n) \leq 0.216n$, by constructing a non-completable partial configuration of fewer than $0.216n$ queens.
relevance_reason: n-queens 문제는 조합론의 고전 문제이지만 McMullen's problem(볼록 위치의 점 배치, oriented matroid, 다면체 기하)과는 직접적 연관성이 없음.
summary: n×n 체스판의 n-queens 완성 임계값 qc(n)에 대한 점근 상한을 0.241n에서 0.216n으로 개선. 0.216n보다 작은 queens의 비완성 부분 배치를 구성하여 이를 달성.
technique: 완성 불가능한 부분 배치의 구체적 구성(construction of non-completable partial configuration)

title: Pseudoshattering Pairs
abstract: For two vectors $x,y\in [b]^k$, consider the bipartite graph with two copies of $[b]$ in which $i$ on the left is joined to $j$ on the right if $(x_t,y_t)=(i,j)$ for some coordinate $t$. We study the largest size of a family $C\subseteq [b]^k$ such that, for every two distinct $x,y\in C$, this bipartite graph contains a cycle.   We give a natural construction for such families and conjecture that it is optimal whenever $k$ is large relative to $b$. We prove an LYM-type upper bound that is asymptotically tight with respect to this construction, and is exact when $k$ is large and divisible by $b$. We then refine the argument using a circular ordering, obtaining the sharp full-support bound when $k\equiv -1\pmod b$. In the case $b=3$, we prove the exact general result when $k\equiv -1\pmod 3$ and $k$ is sufficiently large. The problem is motivated by the Daniely--Shalev-Shwartz dimension and the pseudocube formulation of a higher-alphabet Sauer-Shelah-Perles lemma.
relevance_reason: 이 논문은 조합론의 VC 차원 및 Sauer-Shelah-Perles 보조정리 확장에 관한 것으로, McMullen's problem(볼록위치 점 배치, oriented matroid, realizability)과는 직접적 연관성이 없습니다.
summary: 논문은 두 벡터 $x,y \in [b]^k$에 대해 정의된 이분 그래프가 사이클을 포함하는 족 $C \subseteq [b]^k$의 최대 크기를 연구합니다. LYM형 상한을 증명하고 $k \equiv -1 \pmod{b}$일 때 sharp full-support 경계를 얻으며, $b=3$일 때 특정 조건 하의 정확한 결과를 제시합니다.
technique: LYM형 상한(LYM-type upper bound)과 원형 순서(circular ordering)를 이용한 정제 논증
connections: Sauer-Shelah-Perles 보조정리의 고알파벳 확장 및 Daniely-Shalev-Shwartz VC 차원과 관련

title: The unique self-dual binary code of length 26 with minimum weight 6
abstract: The binary Type~I self-dual [26,13,6] code is classical. We give what appears to be the first direct non-computational proof of its uniqueness. We first determine the weight enumerators of the code and its shadow. Degree-one harmonic MacWilliams identities supply the required 1-designs. Elementary intersection counts then show that the two minimal half-shadows each contain 13 words; these words label the 26 coordinates as 13 points and 13 lines, and the two shadow classes become the point-stars and line-stars. From this structure we give two uniqueness proofs: one reconstructs the projective plane of order 3 and the plane code, including the full automorphism group PGL(3,3):2; the other deletes an intrinsic flag, obtains the odd Golay code together with a deep hole coset, and reconstructs the length 26 code and the size of the automorphism group from this coset datum. Thus the natural length-24 object behind the code is the odd Golay code together with its unique orbit of deep hole cosets.
relevance_reason: 이진 부호의 유일성 증명은 조합론이지만 McMullen's problem (볼록 위치의 점 배치, oriented matroid, 실현성)과는 직접 관련이 없음.
summary: 본 논문은 길이 26, 최소 무게 6인 자기쌍대 이진 부호 [26,13,6]의 유일성에 대한 첫 직접 비계산 증명을 제시한다. MacWilliams 항등식, weight enumerator 분석, 반-그림자(half-shadow) 구조를 이용하여 사영평면 PG(2,3)과의 연결을 통해 유일성을 재구성한다.
technique: Harmonic MacWilliams identities, weight enumerator 분석, intersection counts를 통한 shadow 구조 결정, 및 odd Golay code와의 관계를 통한 재구성.

title: Graded Betti numbers of generalized split--join graphs and applications
abstract: We determine the full graded Betti tables of graph families that subsume several classes studied recently in the literature, namely the generalized multiple complete split-like graphs and the generalized clique-star graphs with arbitrary clique block sizes. The method combines Hochster's formula with a precise decomposition of the associated independence complexes into disjoint unions of simplices and iterated joins of discrete complexes. This reduces every graded Betti number to an explicit coefficient extraction formula and yields closed expressions for the linear strand, higher strands, Hilbert series, regularity, projective dimension, and extremal Betti numbers. In particular, we prove a sharp criterion for $2$-linear resolution and identify the regularity corner in terms of the number of nontrivial clique blocks. As applications, we recover and extend earlier results on equal-block split-like graphs, obtain complete formulas for pineapple graphs, and derive consequences for power graphs of cyclic groups, elementary abelian groups, and prime-power dihedral groups.
relevance_reason: 이 논문은 그래프의 graded Betti 수와 commutative algebra 불변량을 연구하며, McMullen's problem의 핵심인 convex position 점 배치, oriented matroid, 조합 기하학적 구조와는 직접적인 연관이 없습니다.
summary: 본 논문은 generalized split-join 그래프 족의 완전한 graded Betti 표를 결정합니다. Hochster 공식과 independence complex의 단순체와 iterated join으로의 정확한 분해를 결합하여, 선형 strand, Hilbert series, regularity, projective dimension 등에 대한 명시적 공식을 유도합니다.
technique: Hochster 공식과 independence complex의 단순체 분해를 이용한 graded Betti 수 계산.

title: Reconfiguration of Nowhere-zero Flows
abstract: Fix an abelian group $A$, a graph $G$, and nowhere-zero $A$-flows $f'$ and $f''$ on $G$. Now $f'$ and $f''$ are \emph{$A$-flow-adjacent} if there exists a cycle $C$ in $G$ such that $f'(e)-f''(e)=0$ for all edges $e\notin E(C)$. And $f'$ and $f''$ are \emph{$A$-flow-equivalent} if there exists a sequence $f_0,\ldots,f_s$ of $A$-flows such that $f_0=f'$, $f_s=f''$, and $f_i$ and $f_{i-1}$ are $A$-flow-adjacent for all $i\in[s]$. Given a group $A$, we seek conditions on a graph $G$ such that all $A$-flows on $G$ are pairwise $A$-flow-equivalent; in this case, we say that $G$ is \emph{$A$-flow-connected}. Analogously, we define $k$-flow-connectedness for nowhere-zero (integer) $k$-flows. The notions of $A$-flow-connectedness and $k$-flow-connectedness were first investigated by Esperet et al., who showed, among other results, that every $2$-edge-connected graph is $A$-flow-connected whenever $A=\mathbb{Z}_2^8$ or $|A| \ge 1.15\times 10^{694}$.   In this paper, we first characterize the graphs that are $\mathbb{Z}_3$-flow-connected and that are $3$-flow-connected. We show that every 2-edge-connected graph is $A$-flow-connected if and only if this is true for every 2-edge-connected cubic graphs. We show that all cubic bipartite graphs are $\mathbb{Z}_4$-flow-connected, and construct other cubic graphs that are and are not $\mathbb{Z}_4$-flow-connected. We conjecture that every Eulerian graph is $k$-flow-connected and $A$-flow-connected whenever $k$ or $|A|$ is even; and provide evidence for this conjecture. Finally, we consider $4$-edge-connected graphs $G$. Here, we show that $G$ is $A$-flow-connected whenever $|A|\ge 5.3\times 10^6$.
relevance_reason: nowhere-zero flow의 재구성(reconfiguration) 문제는 그래프 조합론의 한 분야이지만, McMullen's problem(고차원 볼록 위치의 점 배치, oriented matroid, chirotope)과는 직접적 이론적 관련성이 없음.
summary: 본 논문은 그래프 $G$에서 두 nowhere-zero $A$-흐름(flow)이 순환 재배치(cycle-by-cycle reconfiguration)를 통해 연결될 수 있는 조건을 연구한다. $\mathbb{Z}_3$-흐름과 3-흐름에 대한 특성화, 3-정규 이분 그래프의 $\mathbb{Z}_4$-흐름-연결성, 4-간선-연결 그래프에 대한 상한을 제시한다.
technique: 재구성 경로(reconfiguration paths)를 통한 흐름 동치류 분석; 3-정규 그래프에 대한 축약적 특성화(reduction to cubic graphs).

title: Perfect State Transfer on Quotient Graphs in Shunt Decomposition-Based Quantum Walks
abstract: This paper investigates perfect state transfer (PST) in discrete-time quantum walks constructed via the shunt decomposition method. The walks are defined on a graph $G$ and its associated quotient graph $G/π$, induced by an equitable partition $π$. Through the shunt decomposition of $G$, we derive an explicit relation between the shift operator of the parent graph $G$ and that of its quotient graph $G/π$. We construct a reflection operator based on the characteristic matrix, which establishes a connection between the transition operator of the parent graph and that of its lower-dimensional quotient graph. We then prove that PST occurs on $G$ if and only if it occurs on $G/π$. Furthermore, we express the unitary evolution operator of the quotient graph in terms of Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind, from which we derive explicit criteria for PST. As an application, we establish PST on the cycle graph $C_{n}$ at time $k = n/2$, and lift the result to the parent graph $C_{2n}$ via the equitable partition $π$. We further show that if an equitable partition $π$ of $G$ induces a quotient isomorphic to $K_n^{\circlearrowleft}$, the complete digraph on $n$ vertices with a loop at every vertex, then PST occurs at step $k = n$, and the walk is periodic at $k = 2n$. This framework is applied to two families of graphs, which are the complete bipartite digraph $K_{n,n}^{\rightleftharpoons}$ and the circulant graph $\operatorname{Circ}(2n, S)$, where $S$ consists of all odd residues modulo $2n$ and $n = 2^s$ for some $s \geq 1$, establishing PST in their respective line digraphs. Collectively, these results also answer the question posed by Godsil and Zhan concerning which shunt decompositions or embeddings of a graph admit PST.
relevance_reason: 양자 보행과 완벽 상태 전송은 이산기하학·조합론의 고전적 구조 문제와 직접 관련이 없음.
summary: 본 논문은 shunt decomposition을 통해 구성된 이산 시간 양자 보행에서 완벽 상태 전송(PST)을 연구한다. 모 그래프 G와 동등분할로 유도된 몫 그래프 G/π 간의 PST 발생 필요충분조건을 증명하고, Chebyshev 다항식을 이용한 명시적 PST 판정법을 제시한다. 순환 그래프, 완전 이분 그래프 등에서 PST 구현을 보인다.
technique: Shunt decomposition, 특성행렬 기반 반사 연산자, Chebyshev 다항식을 통한 unitary 진화 연산자 표현.

title: A Resolution of Erdős Problems 593 and 1177: Obligatory Triple Systems and Exact Spectra
abstract: We resolve Erdős Problems #593 and #1177. Problem #593 asks which finite triple systems occur in every uncountably chromatic triple system; the answer is exactly the class generated from private-vertex expansions of finite bipartite graphs by finite disjoint unions and one-point amalgamations. Equivalently, after isolated vertices are removed, a finite triple system is obligatory precisely when it is linear, every hyperedge-node of its Levi graph has an incident bridge, and every Berge cycle is even.   The proof uses an exact bridge-trace theorem for complete-rank one-apex sequence lifts. We also prove that, for every uncountable cardinal kappa, there is a linear triple system of chromatic number exactly kappa, with at most 2^{2^mu} vertices when kappa=mu^+. These two ingredients give a class-valued exact avoidance-spectrum dichotomy for every finite forbidden triple system. As a consequence, Erdős Problem #1177 has truth values yes, no, and yes.
relevance_reason: 조합론의 하이퍼그래프·색칠수 문제이나 McMullen's problem(볼록위치, 배향매트로이드, 다면체 구조)과는 직접 관련 없음.
summary: Erdős 문제 #593과 #1177을 해결하며, 비계수 삼중계(triple system)에서 필수적으로 나타나는 유한 삼중계를 특성화한다. 이는 이분 그래프의 특정 확장으로부터 생성되는 체계(선형성, Levi 그래프의 다리 조건, 짝수 Berge 순환 조건)로 정확히 규명된다.
technique: complete-rank one-apex sequence lifts에 대한 정확한 bridge-trace 정리와 무한 기수에 대한 정확한 색칠수 구성.

title: Sharp bounds for minimal dependencies of linear-form powers
abstract: Motivated by the dimension-bound part of a problem of Bukh, we study Veronese circuits: how large can the span of $t$ linear forms be if their $m$-th powers are minimally linearly dependent? We prove the sharp finite dimension bound \[   \dim L\leq \frac{t+m-2}{m}. \] Here $\ell_1,\ldots,\ell_t$ are nonzero homogeneous linear forms over a field of characteristic zero, the powers $\ell_1^m,\ldots,\ell_t^m$ form a circuit, and $L=\Span\{\ell_1,\ldots,\ell_t\}$. Rational-normal-curve configurations attain equality for infinitely many pairs $(t,\dim L)$; in particular, the affine bound itself is sharp and the optimal leading constant in Bukh's question is $1/m$.   The proof uses a coding-theoretic translation: the coefficient row space of the powers is the $m$-th Schur power of the coefficient code, and the minimality hypothesis makes this Schur power a full-support hyperplane to which the Schur-product Kneser theorem of Mirandola and Zémor applies. The same method yields flat-concentration and interpolation criteria, a Cayley--Bacharach lower bound, Segre--Veronese and positive-characteristic variants, and Hilbert-function constraints for equality and near-equality in Veronese circuits.
relevance_reason: 선형형식의 거듭제곱에 대한 최소 선형종속성을 다루지만, McMullen's problem의 convex position 점 배치, oriented matroid, 또는 다면체 구조와는 직접 관련이 없음.
summary: 특성 0 체 위에서 $t$개 선형형식의 $m$제곱이 최소선형종속(circuit)을 이룰 때, 그 span의 차원에 대한 sharp bound $\dim L \leq \frac{t+m-2}{m}$을 증명함. Rational-normal-curve 구성이 무한히 많은 경우에 등호를 달성하며, Schur power와 coding theory를 활용한 증명 방법을 제시함.
technique: 코딩이론적 번역(Schur power)과 Schur-product Kneser theorem의 적용.

title: Exact Enumeration of Phylogenetic Networks: The Tree-Child, Reticulation-Visible and Orchard Hierarchy
abstract: We develop a unified framework for the exact enumeration and asymptotic analysis of the three most studied classes of phylogenetic networks: tree-child (TC), reticulation-visible (RV) and orchard networks, whose cardinalities satisfy the strict ordering $|\mathrm{TC}_{\ell,k}|<|\mathrm{RV}_{\ell,k}|<|\mathrm{Orch}_{\ell,k}|$ for reticulation number $k\geq2$ (with $\mathrm{TC}\subsetneq\mathrm{RV}$ and $\mathrm{TC}\subsetneq\mathrm{Orch}$, while $\mathrm{RV}$ and $\mathrm{Orch}$ are incomparable as sets). Using the Chang--Fuchs structural theorem, we derive a two-level master functional equation for the RV bivariate generating function and obtain exact closed-form identities for the differences $Δ_k(\ell):=|RV_{\ell,k}|-|TC_{\ell,k}|$ for $k=2,3$, with the asymptotic universality $Δ_k(\ell)/|TC_{\ell,k}|\sim k!/\ell$. For orchard networks, we prove a \emph{universal hypergeometric law} that resolves the exact enumeration problem for all $\ell$: the column generating function $F_\ell(v)$ is rational with denominator $D_\ell(v)=\prod_{j=2}^\ell X_j(v)$, where \[   X_\ell(v) = \sum_{k=0}^{\lfloor\ell/2\rfloor}(-1)^k\,   \frac{\ell!}{(\ell-2k)!\,k!}\,v^k \] is the matching polynomial of the complete graph $K_\ell$ and a rescaled Jacobi polynomial. This immediately resolves the intractable $\ell=9$ case: $D_9$ has degree 20, dominant growth rate $\approx40.73$, and all spectral roots are positive real. A complete enumeration table is provided extending the published data of Cardona, Ribas and Pons.
relevance_reason: 계산적 조합론과 생성함수 사용하나, McMullen's problem(볼록다각형의 면 수)과는 수학적 주제가 무관.
summary: 트리-차일드(TC), 망상-가시(RV), 과수원(Orchard) 계통망의 세 클래스에 대한 통일된 열거 프레임워크를 개발. Chang-Fuchs 구조 정리를 이용해 RV의 생성함수 함수방정식을 도출하고, 과수원망에 대해 보편 초기하 법칙을 증명하여 모든 $\ell$에 대한 정확한 열거 문제를 해결.
technique: 생성함수 방법, Chang-Fuchs 구조 정리, 완전그래프 $K_\ell$의 매칭 다항식(matching polynomial)과 재스케일된 야코비 다항식(Jacobi polynomial) 활용.

title: Minimal excludant integer and bilateral truncated Jacobi triple product identity
abstract: In 2012, Andrews and Merca proved a truncated theorem on Euler's pentagonal number theorem. Since then, a number of results on truncated theta series have been proved, including truncated Jacobi triple product identity. In this paper, we provide partition-theoretic interpretations for the bilateral truncated Jacobi triple product identity in terms of the minimal excludant integer.
relevance_reason: 논문의 핵심은 분할론(partition theory)과 truncated theta series에 관한 것으로, McMullen's problem이 다루는 convex position, oriented matroid, realizability 등과 직접적 연관이 없음.
summary: 본 논문은 2012년 Andrews와 Merca의 Euler 오각수 정리에 관한 truncated theorem을 바탕으로, bilateral truncated Jacobi triple product identity에 대한 분할론적 해석을 제공한다. minimal excludant integer를 이용하여 이 항등식의 조합론적 의미를 밝힌다.
technique: minimal excludant integer를 활용한 partition-theoretic interpretation과 truncated theta series 항등식의 조합론적 증명.

title: Asymmetric induced saturation
abstract: For which graphs $H$ does there exist a graph $G$ with at least one edge and no induced subgraph isomorphic to $H$, such that deleting any edge of $G$ creates an induced copy of $H$? We call such a graph "$H$-deletion-saturated". This version of the well-studied notion of "$H$-induced-saturated" graphs -- where both adding and deleting any edge creates an induced copy of $H$ -- appears more tractable. For example, while it remains wide open whether $H$-induced-saturated graphs exist for every even cycle $H$, we proved recently that deletion-saturated graphs exist for all even cycles. In fact, apart from complete graphs, no graph $H$ is known for which $H$-deletion-saturated graphs do not exist. We conjecture that $H$-deletion-saturated graphs exist for every non-complete graph $H$, and prove this conjecture for several types of graphs, including: complete bipartite graphs with parts of unequal size, triangle-free graphs with one cycle, graphs with two leaves at distance at most three, and line graphs of trees. In fact, in all cases, we prove the conjecture for substantially more general families. We also verify our conjecture for every graph $H$ on at most six vertices.
relevance_reason: 극단 그래프 존재성 문제이지만 McMullen's problem(d=5, convex position, oriented matroid, polyhedral structure)과는 기하학적·조합적 구조가 근본적으로 무관.
summary: 그래프 $H$에 대해 $H$-deletion-saturated 그래프의 존재성을 연구한다. 이는 $H$-induced-saturated 개념의 비대칭 버전으로, 임의의 간선 삭제가 유도된 $H$ 복사본을 생성하는 그래프를 찾는 문제이다. 완전 그래프를 제외한 모든 그래프에 대해 해당 그래프가 존재한다는 추측을 제시하고 여러 그래프 클래스에서 증명한다.

title: Forcing monochromatic induced subgraphs
abstract: We prove that for all $c\in\mathbb N$ and nonnull graphs $H_1,\ldots,H_t$, there exists $n\in\mathbb N$ such that if $G$ is a $c$-edge-colored complete graph with no monochromatic induced copy of the complete join of $H_1,\ldots,H_t$, then $V(G)$ is the union of $n$ sets $V_1,\ldots,V_n$ such that within each set $V_j$ with $|V_j|\neq 1$, the edges of some color form a graph that excludes at least one of $H_1,\ldots,H_t$ as an induced subgraph. In fact, the same holds even if the colors overlap, and with a different list of graphs $H_1,\ldots,H_t$ assigned to each color. When $H_1,\ldots,H_t$ each have a single vertex, this is Ramsey's theorem, and when $c=2$, this is the "excluding pairs of graphs" theorem of Chudnovsky, Scott, and Seymour.
relevance_reason: 이산기하학의 McMullen 문제와 달리, 본 논문은 그래프 색칠 및 Ramsey 이론 문제로 조합론의 다른 분야에 속함.
summary: 본 논문은 c-간선 색칠 완전그래프에서 특정 그래프들의 단색 유도 부분그래프를 피할 때, 꼭짓점 집합을 n개의 부분으로 분할할 수 있음을 증명한다. Ramsey 정리와 Chudnovsky-Scott-Seymour의 두 그래프 제외 정리를 일반화한다.

title: Turán results for posets and their alternating cycles
abstract: For a partially ordered set ${\mathbb{P}} = (X,\leq)$ there exist hypergraphs where the vertices are the set of ordered tuples of either all incomparable elements of ${\mathbb{P}}$ or all the critical pairs of ${\mathbb{P}}$, and the edges are formed by the duals of either all the alternating cycles of ${\mathbb{P}}$ or all the strict alternating cycles of ${\mathbb{P}}$. The weak chromatic numbers of these hypergraphs are all equal to the order dimension of ${\mathbb{P}}$. Here are established upper bounds on the number of strict alternating cycles a poset ${\mathbb{P}}=(X,\leq)$ can have in terms of $n = |X|$, the cardinality of the groundset of ${\mathbb{P}}$, and the width $w$ of ${\mathbb{P}}$. These bounds also apply to the number of hyperedges of the associated hypergraph ${\mathcal{H}}^s(\mathbb{P})$, with incomparable pairs as vertices and strict alternating cycles dual to its hyperedges.
relevance_reason: Order dimension과 poset structure는 combinatorial geometry와 관련이 있지만, McMullen's problem의 convex position, oriented matroid, realizability 등과는 직접적 연관이 없음.
summary: Poset의 alternating cycle과 strict alternating cycle의 개수에 대한 Turán 유형의 상한을 확립한다. Poset의 incomparable element들과 critical pair들로 정의된 hypergraph의 weak chromatic number가 poset의 order dimension과 같음을 보인다.
technique: Hypergraph 색칠수(weak chromatic number)와 poset의 width를 이용한 조합론적 상한 도출

title: Winding number and circular coloring
abstract: In 1996, Youngs proved a surprising theorem that quadrangulations of the projective plane could never have chromatic number exactly 3. This sparked a lot of interest, and the result has been further developed in many directions over the past decades. For example, the result is strengthened by considering the circular chromatic number, which is a real-valued lower bound on the chromatic number. The circular chromatic number of a quadrangulation cannot be in the interval (2,4). This parameter allows a generalization to larger even faces, for which a similar gap exists.   In this work, we place these results into a framework based on the notion of winding number using extensions of colorings to continuous mappings. This yields unified and simplified proofs of gaps in the circular chromatic number for graphs with a distinguished set of directed even cycles. This generalizes the setting of graphs embedded on surfaces where every face is even.   We further establish an analogous gap phenomenon when all faces are of a given odd length, previously known only in the case of triangulations. For example, we conclude that if G is a graph embedded on the projective plane such that all faces are 5-cycles, then either its circular chromatic number is 5/2 or at least 3, the former being the case only if G is Eulerian and every noncontractible facial walk is of odd length...
relevance_reason: 이 논문은 사영평면 위 그래프의 원형 색수(circular chromatic number)와 winding number에 관한 연구로, McMullen 문제나 oriented matroid와 직접적인 관련이 없다.
summary: 이 논문은 Youngs(1996)의 사영평면 사각분할(quadrangulation) 정리—크로매틱 수가 정확히 3이 될 수 없다는 결과—를 winding number와 연속 매핑으로의 채색 확장 개념을 통해 통합·일반화한다. 방향 있는 짝수 사이클을 가진 그래프에서 원형 색수의 gap 현상에 대한 통일된 증명을 제시하며, 홀수 길이 면을 가진 경우(예: 5-사이클 면)에도 유사한 gap 현상을 새롭게 확립한다.
technique: winding number를 이용한 채색의 연속 매핑으로의 확장을 핵심 도구로 사용하여 원형 색수의 gap 현상을 통합 증명한다.

title: On $k$-color mex-related partition functions
abstract: In this paper, we investigate a set of $k$-color partitions and examine how its subsets relates to the theory of the minimal excludant function introduced by Andrews and Newman. Furthermore, we provide generalization of the partition functions introduced by Andrews and Bachraoui and also define several new partition functions within this framework.
relevance_reason: 본 논문은 분할함수(partition functions)와 mex 함수를 다루며, McMullen's problem은 볼록기하학의 조합론적 구조에 관한 것으로 직접적인 관련성이 없음.
summary: 이 논문은 k-색 분할(k-color partitions)과 Andrews-Newman의 최소배제함수(minimal excludant function) 이론의 관계를 조사합니다. Andrews-Bachraoui가 도입한 분할함수를 일반화하고 이 체계 내에서 새로운 분할함수들을 정의합니다.
technique: 최소배제함수 이론과 k-색 분할의 조합론적 관계 분석을 통한 분할함수의 일반화.

title: Structural Properties and Applications of the Augmented Sombor Index
abstract: Topological indices are key quantitative descriptors in mathematical chemistry, unchanged under symmetry operations and retaining graph connectivity; they capture molecular structural features to provide insights into molecular stability and chemical properties, becoming indispensable in cheminformatics and theoretical chemistry. Among degree-based indices, the \textbf{Sombor index} is widely concerned for capturing structural information, and motivated by enhanced structural discrimination, the \textbf{augmented Sombor index} ($ASO$) is defined for a connected graph $Ω$ with $|V(Ω)|\geq 3$ as $$ASO(Ω) = \sum_{v_iv_j\in E(Ω)} \sqrt{\frac{d_i^2 + d_j^2}{d_i + d_j - 2}},$$ where $d_i$ and $d_j$ are the degrees of vertices $v_i$ and $v_j$, respectively. Within the scope of this study, we first establish several sharp bounds for the augmented Sombor index and characterize the extremal graphs attaining these bounds. In particular, we determine the minimum value of the $ASO$ index for unicyclic graphs with a prescribed girth and characterize all graphs achieving this minimum. We also identify the second maximum $ASO$ value among trees and characterize the corresponding extremal tree structures. Furthermore, the minimum and maximum values of the $ASO$ index for bipartite graphs and chemical graphs are obtained, together with a complete characterization of the associated extremal graphs. In addition, we characterize the chemical trees that maximize the $ASO$ index. The chemical applicability of the $ASO$ index is investigated through quantitative structure-property relationship (QSPR) analysis, supported by a comparative assessment of several variants of the Sombor index. Finally, we present concluding remarks and outline potential directions for future research on the augmented Sombor index of graphs.
relevance_reason: 논문은 그래프의 위상 지표(topological indices) 최적화 문제를 다루지만, McMullen's problem의 핵심인 convex position 점 배치, oriented matroid, 실현가능성(realizability) 등과는 무관.
summary: 본 논문은 화학그래프와 조합구조에 대한 augmented Sombor index(ASO)를 정의하고, 다양한 그래프 클래스(유니사이클 그래프, 트리, 이분 그래프, 화학그래프)에서의 최솟값과 최댓값을 특성화한다. QSPR 분석을 통해 화학적 응용 가능성을 검증한다.
technique: 차수(degree) 기반 위상지표의 극값 특성화(extremal graph characterization).

title: The Angular Seed Power Map: A Constructive Approach to Recursive Scaling Spirals
abstract: We present the ''Power Spiral Map'', a continuous angular evolution of the linear coordinate grid established in our previous work. While that previous Power Map utilized a seed value translating along a horizontal axis, this work builds upon a seed angle ($θ$) projected onto a unit diameter circle. This operation controls two coupled geometric behaviors: an internal area-preserving partition of unity within a reference square (cos 2 $θ$ + sin 2 $θ$ = 1) and an external recursive scaling mechanism (sec $θ$ and cos $θ$) that dictates the expansion or contraction of successive generations of squares unfolding as a spiral in the 2D plane. We demonstrate that continuous variation of this angular parameter generates discrete geometric alignments that yield polynomial identities, with examples of the Golden Ratio ($Φ$) and the Plastic Ratio ($ψ$) defined through purely planar intersections.
comment: This is a new submission (v1) intended for cross-listing/transfer to arXiv under the mathematics/geometry category
relevance_reason: 원형 기반 나선 구조와 기하학적 분할을 다루지만 McMullen의 문제(convex position 점 배치, oriented matroid, realizability)와는 직접 관련 없음.
summary: 각도 매개변수 θ를 기반으로 단위원 위의 seed angle을 투영하여 Power Spiral Map을 구성함. 이를 통해 참조 정사각형 내 면적 보존 분할(partition of unity)과 외부 재귀적 스케일링 메커니즘(sec θ, cos θ)을 제어하여 2D 평면에 나선을 생성함. 연속적인 각도 변화가 이산 기하학적 정렬을 산출하며 황금비와 플라스틱 비를 포함한 다항식 항등식을 도출함.
technique: 각도 매개변수화된 나선 구성과 면적 보존 분할을 통한 재귀적 스케일링 메커니즘.

title: Linear relations for Tutte polynomials of semimatroids
abstract: We establish a family of linear relations for the coefficients of the Tutte polynomial of a semimatroid. We also introduce ranked central sets, a mild generalization of semimatroids, and prove that the same identities hold in this broader setting. The proof relies on the specialization $x=\frac{z}{z-1}$, $y=z$ along the hyperbola $(x-1)(y-1)=1$; under this specialization, the edge subgraph expansion over central sets reduces to the $f$-polynomial of the central set complex. As applications, we obtain explicit formulas for Tutte polynomials of affine hyperplane arrangements and for balanced Tutte polynomials of biased graphs, whose central sets are central subarrangements and balanced edge sets, respectively. Our results recover the generalized Brylawski's identities for Tutte polynomials of ranked sets, matroids and graphs.
relevance_reason: Tutte polynomial identities와 semimatroid는 조합론적 기하학의 일반적 구조를 다루지만, McMullen's problem (convex position, oriented matroid, realizability)과는 직접적 연관이 없음.
summary: 논문은 세미매트로이드(semimatroid)의 Tutte 다항식 계수에 대한 선형 관계식족을 확립하고, 이를 순위가 있는 중심 집합(ranked central sets)으로 일반화한다. 특수화 $x=\frac{z}{z-1}$, $y=z$를 사용하여 중심 집합 복합체의 $f$-다항식과 연결시킨다. 초록 다항식 배열(affine hyperplane arrangement)과 편향 그래프(biased graph)의 균형 Tutte 다항식에 명시 공식을 제공한다.
technique: 중심 집합 복합체의 $f$-다항식으로의 축약을 통한 하이퍼볼라 특수화 $(x-1)(y-1)=1$ 기법.

title: A Simple Counting Argument for Dense Linear Hypergraphs
abstract: In connection to the Brown-Erdős-Sós conjecture, we give a short local averaging proof of a density theorem for linear uniform hypergraphs. Let $r \ge 3$, $k \ge 3$, and suppose that $n \ge (r-2)(k-2)+1$. If $H$ is a linear $r$-uniform hypergraph on $n$ vertices and \[|E(H)| \geq \frac{k-2}{r^2((r-2)(k-2)+1)}n^2 + \frac{n}{r},\] then $H$ contains $k$ edges spanning at most $(r-2)k+3$ vertices. In the standard linear-density normalization, this gives the asymptotic density threshold $c \geq \frac{r-1}{r} \cdot \frac{k-2}{(r-2)(k-2)+1} + o(1)$. In particular, this yields a simple proof of the large-uniformity form of the Brown-Erdős-Sós theorem, due to Keevash and Long. In the case of triple systems, our bound becomes $c \geq \frac{2(k-2)}{3(k-1)} + o(1)$, improving upon a bound of $\frac{4}{5}$ due to Santos and Tyomkyn.
relevance_reason: 극단 조합론의 밀도 문제로, McMullen's problem의 중심인 점 배치와 구조적 정리와는 직접적 연관성 없음.
summary: 본 논문은 Brown-Erdős-Sós 추측 관련 선형 균일 초그래프의 밀도 정리를 국소 평균화 논증으로 증명한다. 주어진 간선 수 조건 하에서 $k$개 간선이 최대 $(r-2)k+3$개 정점을 생성함을 보이며, 특히 삼중계 경우 $c \geq \frac{2(k-2)}{3(k-1)} + o(1)$의 개선된 밀도 임계값을 도출한다.
technique: 국소 평균화 논증(local averaging argument)을 통한 밀도 임계값 증명

title: Lower bounds on non-central sections of isotropic convex bodies
abstract: For fixed $t_0 \in [0,\sqrt{3}]$ we give asymptotically sharp lower bounds on the quantity $L_K \text{vol}_{d-1}(K \cap H)$, where $H$ is a hyperplane at distance $t_0 L_K$ from the origin, $K$ is any symmetric isotropic convex body in $\mathbb{R}^d$, and $L_K$ stands for the isotropic constant of $K$.
relevance_reason: 고차원 볼록체의 단면(section) 기하학을 다루지만, McMullen's problem의 핵심인 convex position 점 배치, oriented matroid, 조합 구조와는 직접 관련이 없음.
summary: 대칭 등방(isotropic) 볼록체 $K$에 대해, 원점으로부터 거리 $t_0 L_K$에 있는 초평면과의 교집합의 부피에 대한 점근적으로 정확한 하한을 제시한다. 등방 상수(isotropic constant) $L_K$를 활용한 고차원 볼록기하 분석이다.
technique: 이등방 볼록체의 측도론적 성질과 단면 부피 추정을 이용한 하한 도출.

title: Extremal Deletion-Ball Intersections under Run-Count and Lower-Order Deletion-Ball Intersection Constraints
abstract: Motivated by sequence reconstruction and reconstruction codes, we study extremal intersections of deletion balls over a fixed $q$-ary alphabet. Let $Σ_q^n$ be the set of sequences of length $n$ over $Σ_q$, and let $D_t(x)$ denote the set of all sequences obtained from $x\inΣ_q^n$ by deleting exactly $t$ symbols.   Our first result gives a finite upper bound under a lower-order deletion-correction constraint. We prove that if $x,y\inΣ_q^n$ satisfy $D_{s-1}(x)\cap D_{s-1}(y)=\varnothing$, then \[ |D_t(x)\cap D_t(y)| \le \binom{2s}{s}\binom{n-s}{t-s}. \] For binary alphabets, this strengthens a recent asymptotic upper bound of Pham, Goyal, and Kiah (2025, JCTA). We then investigate deletion-ball intersections under simultaneous constraints on run counts and lower-order deletion-ball intersections. For fixed $0<γ\le1$, integers $1\le s\le t$, and $m\ge1$, we show that if $x,y\inΣ_q^n$ have at most $γn$ runs and satisfy $|D_s(x)\cap D_s(y)|\le m$, then \[ |D_t(x)\cap D_t(y)|\le \frac{mγ^{t-s}}{(t-s)!}n^{t-s}+O_{s,t,m}(n^{t-s-1}). \] Moreover, the leading term can be attainable whenever $m$ is realized by a fixed finite-length seed pair. As a consequence, we obtain a direct lifting theorem for deletion reconstruction codes, transferring reconstruction properties from radius $s$ to larger radii $t$. Finally, we establish a parallel insertion theory and derive corresponding results for insertion-ball intersections and insertion reconstruction codes.

title: On the Periodicity of k-distance Graphs
abstract: The $k$-distance graph $G^k$ of a graph $G$ has the same vertex set as $G$ and two vertices are adjacent if and only if their distance is $k$ in $G$. These graphs have been extensively studied for their connection properties. In this paper, we study various properties of these graphs, including clique number and periodicity. For all $k$, we show that there exists a $k$-distance graph that is weakly periodic for any size period. Our main result is a proof that if $k > 2$ then there exists a $k$-distance graph of any size (strong) period. Finally, we provide evidence that there exists an upper bound on the periodicity of a connected $2$-distance graph as a function of $|V|$.
